name: wastecrossing
description: Void-travel Slice 1 (walking skeleton): strike out from a `flags.void_gate` edge tile — by walking off the map (movement.edge hook) or the `venture` verb — into a generated LINEAR chain of transient waste rooms that deposits you at a distant region on foot. Rooms are synthetic (non-DB) zones via the transient-zone substrate; relog-safe through crossing_* player_flags. No loot/encounters/parties/traces yet.
